opening.comment: The greeting gives only the company name; the agent did not state their own name as required.

verification.quote: Agent: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name and order number before looking at the order, which is correct.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi, I cent a return back two week ago and I still haven't had my refund.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the return and refund issue and did not re-ask for details already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Refunds take 10 to 40 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving at the warehouse, so the stated 10 to 40 days and the timeline given are wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Refunds take 10 to 40 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
process_compliance.comment: No hold was requested, so that step does not apply; the agent did not violate any required step on this call, though the refund process was misstated.

communication.quote: Agent: I understand, worrying when money is outstanding.
communication.comment: The agent acknowledged the caller's worry politely, and the caller was not described as upset beyond mild worry.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll got an email this day it's paid. Is they're anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and gave a next step, but the next step was unclear and garbled, so it was not clearly confirmed.
